一根竖着的杆：能扶、能握，放倒了就是横杆: An upright pole to hold or grip; lay it down for a horizontal bar
一个方箱子：能坐、能踩、能靠: A square box to sit on, step on or lean against
一个圆台子：圆凳、圆桌、垫脚的台: A round stand: a stool, a round table or a step
一个球：压扁、拉长都行: A ball; squash or stretch it as you like
一面墙板：能靠、能撑，放平了就是地台、床板: A wall panel to lean or push against; lay it flat for a platform or a bed board
换回白模的灰色: Change back to the base-mesh gray
竖直落下去：落到地面，或者正下方别的道具上（箱子叠箱子、东西放到台面上）: Drops straight down onto the ground, or onto another prop right below it (stack boxes, put things on a table top)
倾斜归零，立正；朝哪边不变: Clears the tilt so it stands straight; the facing stays the same
照选中的道具再做一个，放在它旁边: Makes another one like the selected prop and puts it beside it
从场景里拿掉；点撤销能放回来: Removes it from the scene; "Undo" brings it back
道具是给姿势当依托的：坐的、扶的、靠的、踩的。它归整个场景，不跟着哪个角色；「保: Props give a pose something to rest on: things to sit on, hold, lean against or step on. They belong to the whole scene, not to one character; "Save scene" includes them, "Save config" doesn't. Click a prop in the 3D view to select it, then drag the arrows to move, the rings to rotate and the cubes to resize (hold Shift for 5 cm and 15° steps; keys: W move, E rotate, R scale, Delete to remove). Undo and redo treat prop changes and character changes as one sequence, in the order you made them.
放了一个{kind}。在 3D 视图里拖箭头挪它，面板里能改尺寸、颜色。: Added: {kind}. Drag the arrows in the 3D view to move it; size and color are in the panel.
复制了一份「{name}」，放在它旁边。: Duplicated "{name}" and put the copy beside it.
「{name}」已经落在下面的东西上了。: "{name}" is already resting on what's below it.
导出整个场景时把场景里的道具一起写进文件；去掉就只有角色: Writes the props in the scene into the file when exporting the whole scene; untick to export the characters only
道具素材的文件大小不对: The prop asset file has the wrong size
宽、高、深都变回刚放下时的大小: Sets width, height and depth back to what they were when it was first placed
{part}钉在「{name}」上了：挪这件道具它跟着走，拖身体别处时它留在道具: {part} is pinned to "{name}": it follows when you move the prop, and stays on it when you drag the rest of the body.
「{who}」整个人跟着「{name}」了：挪它、转它，人跟着走。: "{who}" now follows "{name}": move or turn the prop and the whole figure goes with it.
解开以后，挪这件道具它不再跟着: Once detached, it no longer follows when you move this prop
坐着、躺着、站在这件道具上时用：挪它、转它，整个人跟着走: For sitting, lying or standing on this prop: move or turn it and the whole figure goes with it
握着、扶着、撑着、踩着这件道具时用：挪它，这只手（脚）跟着走；拖身体别处时它留在: For holding, leaning on or stepping on this prop: move it and this hand (foot) follows; it stays on the prop when you drag the rest of the body
已经落在下面的东西上了。: Already resting on what is below.
落到了下面的道具上（离地 {cm} 厘米）。: Dropped onto the prop below ({cm} cm above the ground).
坐着、躺着、站在这件道具上时用：挪它、转它，整个人跟着走。只让一只手、一只脚跟着: For sitting, lying or standing on this prop: move or turn it and the whole figure goes with it. To make just one hand or foot follow, pick that hand or foot in Pose and click "Pin to…"
脚下离地多高：站到台子上、台阶上时用: How high the feet are above the ground: for standing on a stand or a step
整个人竖直落下去：落到地面，或者脚下的道具上（先把「离地」调到台子上面，再点它就: Drops the whole figure straight down: onto the ground, or onto the prop under its feet (raise Height above a stand first, then click this to stand on it)
「{who}」坐到「{name}」上了：挪这件道具、转它，人跟着走。: "{who}" is sitting on "{name}": move or turn the prop and the figure goes with it.
「{who}」躺到「{name}」上了：挪这件道具、转它，人跟着走。: "{who}" is lying on "{name}": move or turn the prop and the figure goes with it.
「{who}」两手撑在「{name}」上了：挪这件道具，手跟着走。: "{who}" has both hands on "{name}": move the prop and the hands follow.
「{who}」的{part}扶在「{name}」上了：挪这件道具，这只手跟着走。: "{who}" is holding "{name}" with the {part}: move the prop and that hand follows.
「{who}」背靠在「{name}」上了：挪这件道具、转它，人跟着走。: "{who}" is leaning back against "{name}": move or turn the prop and the figure goes with it.
坐到这件道具上：有靠背的朝前坐，没靠背的坐在离角色最近的那一边；脚够得着就踩着地: Sits on this prop: facing forward if it has a back, otherwise on the side nearest the figure, facing out. Feet rest on the ground if they reach, and hang if they don't. Afterwards the whole figure follows the prop
仰面躺到这件道具上。躺好以后整个人跟着它: Lies face up on this prop. Afterwards the whole figure follows the prop
站到离得最近的那一边，两只手撑在台面上。撑好以后两只手钉在它上面: Stands at the nearest side with both hands on the top. Afterwards both hands are pinned to the prop
一只手扶（握）在这件道具上：够得着就原地伸手、别的姿势不动，够不着就走过去站好再: Puts one hand on this prop (or grips it): if it is within reach the figure just reaches out and the rest of the pose stays; if not, it walks over, stands straight and then reaches. Afterwards that hand is pinned to the prop. Click again for the other hand
走到这件道具跟前，背过身靠在上面。靠好以后整个人跟着它: Walks up to this prop, turns around and leans back against it. Afterwards the whole figure follows the prop
这件道具上没有能坐的地方: This prop has nowhere to sit
这件道具上没有能躺的地方: This prop has nowhere to lie
这件道具上没有能撑手的台面: This prop has no top to put hands on
一键动作只管两条腿的人形；这个身体请自己摆（摆好以后可以点「整个人跟着」「钉在…: One-click actions only work for two-legged humanoids; pose this body by hand (then use "Whole body follows" or "Pin to…")
这件道具歪着：先点「摆正」: This prop is tilted: click "Upright" first
台面太矮，撑不着: The top is too low to put hands on
台面太高，撑不着: The top is too high to put hands on
够不着：先把道具挪近一点: Out of reach: move the prop closer first
这件道具太矮，靠不住: This prop is too low to lean on
这件素材没下下来：连不上下载站。看看网络，再点一次: This prop could not be downloaded: the download site cannot be reached. Check the network and click again
场景里有 {n} 件写实款这台设备上还没下载，先用方块顶着：选中它，点「下载」。: {n} realistic prop(s) in this scene are not on this device yet and are shown as boxes: select one and click "Download".
「{name}」还在下载，下完会自己放进场景。: "{name}" is still downloading; it will be placed in the scene when it finishes.
「{name}」取到了，存在这台设备上，下次不用再下。: "{name}" is ready and saved on this device; it will not be downloaded again.
下载并放一件{name}（{size} 厘米；要下 {bytes}，只下这一次）: Download and place a {name} ({size} cm; a {bytes} download, once only)
写实款带贴图，不在安装包里：点哪件才下载哪件，下过的留在这台设备上，之后不联网也: Realistic props have textures and are not part of the installer: each one is downloaded when you click it, stays on this device and works offline afterwards.
不用它自己的贴图，和别的道具一样刷成一个颜色；导出的文件里也是: Drops its own textures and paints it one colour like the other props; exported files too
这台设备上还没有这件的文件，先用方块顶着: This prop's file is not on this device yet; a box stands in for it
从下载站取这一件，只下这一次: Gets this one prop from the download site, once only
放了一件{kind}。在 3D 视图里拖箭头挪它，面板里能改尺寸；勾上「刷成灰色: Placed a {kind}. Drag the arrows in the 3D view to move it and change its size in the panel; tick "Paint grey" to give it one colour like the other props.
场景里没有这件道具: There is no such prop in the scene
已保存姿势 {file}（带着连着的 {n} 件道具），{where}。: Saved the pose as {file} (with the {n} prop(s) it is attached to), {where}.
这个姿势是连着 {n} 件道具一起存的（{names}）。连道具一起放进场景吗？: This pose was saved together with {n} prop(s) ({names}). Put the props into the scene as well?
已载入姿势 {name}，连着的 {n} 件道具也放进场景了。: Loaded the pose {name}; its {n} prop(s) were placed in the scene too.
现在做不了：正在拖动，或者模型还在生成: Not possible right now: something is being dragged, or the model is still being generated
「{who}」吊在「{name}」上了：挪这件道具、转它，人跟着走。: "{who}" is hanging from "{name}": move or turn the prop and the whole figure goes with it.
「{who}」缠在「{name}」上了：挪这件道具、转它，人跟着走。要换成另一条: "{who}" is wrapped around "{name}": move or turn the prop and the whole figure goes with it. To put the other leg on top, click "Flip horizontally" under "Pose".
还是「场景」这一栏，往下是「道具」：杆、箱子、台子，还有现成的椅子、沙发、床、桌: Still in the "Scene" section, further down is "Props": poles, boxes, stands and ready-made chairs, sofas, beds and tables to put in the scene for poses to rest on. Select a prop and click "Sit on it", "Lie on it", "Hands on top" or "Hang": the character is posed on it in one step, and follows the prop when you move it afterwards.
两只手握着横杆吊在下面：杆够高就整个人悬空，矮一点就屈着膝。吊好以后整个人跟着它: Hangs under a horizontal bar by both hands: clear of the floor if the bar is high enough, with bent knees if it is lower. Afterwards the whole figure follows the bar. Needs a horizontal pole (select a pole and click "Lay flat")
两只手握着竖杆，身体离地，两条腿一高一低勾在杆上。缠好以后整个人跟着它。要一根竖: Both hands grip an upright pole, the body is off the floor and the legs hook around the pole, one high and one low. Afterwards the whole figure follows the pole. Needs an upright pole
这个动作要一根杆：放一根「杆」，或者细长的箱子: This action needs a pole: place a "Pole", or a long thin box
杆要横着才吊得上去：选中它点「横过来」: The pole has to be horizontal to hang from: select it and click "Lay flat"
杆要竖着才缠得上去：选中它点「竖起来」（或者「摆正」）: The pole has to be upright to wrap around: select it and click "Stand up" (or "Upright")
这根杆太粗，握不住: This pole is too thick to grip
这根杆太短，两只手握不下: This pole is too short for two hands
这根杆太矮，吊不起来：把它抬高一点: This bar is too low to hang from: raise it a little
这根杆太矮，缠不上去：把它拉高一点: This pole is too short to climb: make it taller
没有「{kind}」这种道具: There is no kind of prop called "{kind}"
把杆竖回去，立在地面上: Stands the pole back up on the floor
把杆转成横的、抬到 2.1 米高：角色能吊在上面（一键动作「吊着」）: Turns the pole horizontal and raises it to 2.1 m so a character can hang from it (the one-click action "Hang")
